# Raw constructor carrier allocation

Independently authored Java8 classes pass the original contravariant callback
into a nongeneric raw wrapper constructor, then pass that wrapper into a scoped
generic superclass constructor. No generic wrapper Signature is invented.
The frozen observer checks original reference capture, wrapper and parent
initialization order, partially initialized fields, exact failures, delayed
reads and ignored results. Source and SDK profiles compile every recovered
Java25 unit and compare original metadata, roles, Exceptions and helper lists.
Signature-only controls retain Code; independent wrong programs must fail the
same observer before recovery starts. Private application code is never used.
